rows.en: That squares our debt with you.
It just so happened that this time, we were the ones doing the rescuing.
But those were some terrible wounds. What on earth happened to you?
Zero told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Mebius told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Seven told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Ultraman told them what had happened inside the Cube.
OOO told them what had happened inside the Cube.
W told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Black RX told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Rider 1 told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Den-O told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Nu Gundam told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Zeta Gundam told them what had happened inside the Cube.
Wing Zero told them what had happened inside the Cube.
00 told them what had happened inside the Cube.
...Belial... So he has finally shown himself.
Every kind of "evil" imaginable has gathered in this world...
That being the case, it was only natural that Belial would appear.
We must quickly regain our true power too. As we are, we'll struggle to fight through what lies ahead.
Belial claims to have stolen the Plasma Spark, but it seems the Land of Light isn't completely dead yet.
In other words, that's proof an ember of the energy core still remains.
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Where is it...?
Most likely with Ultraman Taro. He'd have protected that ember even at the cost of his life.
That would be just like Taro.
All right, everyone. Let's go rescue Taro.
Of course!
The more allies we have, the better.
I heard everything.
Take this with you. You'll need it to save Brother Taro.
Obtained the "Magnerium Medicalizer".
What's this...?
It's the "Magnerium Medicalizer".
It's the Magnerium Ray that once saved Brother Seven, made into a Meteor cartridge.
Good. Take this and head for the Plasma Spark Tower.
...Wait a moment.
An Ultra Sign is coming in.
"Assemble at the Colosseum"...?
What does that mean?
Isn't this the "game" Belial was talking about?
Forget that crap! Let's hurry up and rescue Ultraman Taros already!
Sempai, it's not Taros, it's Taro!
Huh? It ain't?
But to reach the Plasma Spark Tower, we have to pass through the Colosseum either way.
Isn't there another route?
...As I told you before, the layout inside the Cube differs from the real Land of Light.
The only route I've seen with my own eyes is the one that goes through the Colosseum.
It can't be helped. Let's head to the Colosseum for now.
Still... a "game," huh... What is the enemy plotting...?
Brother Zoffy, Ace and I will try entering that game.
Oh, you'll do it...!
Yes. We may be able to learn what the enemy has up their sleeve.
...You'd feel a little uneasy with just the two of you, wouldn't you?
I'll join too.
Accel...!
Whoa, if that's how it is, count me in too!
Birth too!
Very well. Jack, Ace, Accel, Birth: the four of you will enter that game as a team.
Roger!
Nu Gundam and the others will make for the Plasma Spark Tower...
However, if you can't secure a route to the tower, Nu Gundam and the others will also join the game
and scout out the enemy.
You said the entrance to the Plasma Spark Tower was at the back of the Ultra Colosseum, right?
{8074} and company, I presume? We've been waiting for you.
You are invited competitors. Your entry has already been taken care of.
Go on through!
Beyond here is the arena. No one may enter until the opening ceremony.

notes.note: No speakers recovered for 0403 #0.152-0.229; all inferred from context. #0.152-0.153: Jack and/or Ace (#0.151 says they rescued the heroes), repaying the heroes for freeing them in Cube 3. Which of the two says which row is unconfirmed.
Zoffy (commander at the base, formal register); also inferred for #0.170-0.176, #0.202-0.205, #0.211, #0.213-0.214, #0.218, #0.225-0.229.

#0.156-0.168 leader narration, one per leader (each names the leader): Zero, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, RX, Rider 1, Den-O, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00. Source writes plain 'RX' at #0.162; used glossary 'Black RX'.
#0.177-0.189 thirteen identical leader variants -> identical English; 'it' = the energy-core ember (#0.176), subject restored.
'Most likely Ultraman Taro' = the ember is probably with Taro; 'with' added to make the referent clear. Speaker probably Zoffy or Seven; #0.192 Jack/Ace/Seven; #0.193-0.195 unassigned.

Newcomer who 'heard everything', calls Taro and Seven 'nii-san' and hands over a Meteor (GUYS tech) cartridge: likely Hikari (the base's engineer), though Mebius would also fit the 'Brother' address. 'Brother X' per established niisan convention.
Key item 'Magnerium Medicalizer' (Ultraman Mebius Meteor; not in glossary). 'Magnerium Ray' and 'Meteor cartridge' (#0.201) likewise use franchise English. Check against item table later.
'Ultra Sign' not in glossary; franchise English. 'Colosseum' (#0.205) / 'Ultra Colosseum' (0404 #0.1) not in glossary either.
Momotaros (rough, 'mushi mushi' -> 'Forget that crap!'). 'Ultraman Taros' is his mix-up of Taro with Imagin naming; kept. #0.209 another Imagin (Sempai = Momotaros), #0.210 Momotaros.
Jack ('ore', 'Zoffy nii-san', 'Ace and I'); #0.219 Jack. #0.220-0.221 Accel (named at #0.222); #0.223 Birth (named at #0.224).
kokorobosoi = feeling uneasy for lack of backup; rendered 'feel a little uneasy'.

Source hard-codes 'Nu Gundam-tachi' (not the {8074} leader variable) in #0.227-0.228; kept literal. Possibly a script quirk; verify in-game. #0.228-0.229 is one sentence cut across two rows; English cut at the matching point.
{8074} = party leader variable; padding dropped per brief.

report: All 80 rows translated. 0403 #0.152-0.229 have no recovered speakers; assigned from context (Jack/Ace, Zoffy, Momotaros/Imagin, Accel, Birth; #0.196-0.201 likely Hikari). #0.227-0.228 hard-code Nu Gundam. Not in glossary: Magnerium Medicalizer, Magnerium Ray, Meteor cartridge, Ultra Sign, Plasma Spark (Tower), (Ultra) Colosseum, energy core.
